title: Horizon Developments launches Palm Crest Phase 3 in New Cairo
snippet: Horizon Developments launched Phase 3 of its Palm Crest compound in New Cairo on Sunday, adding 420 apartments and townhouses.

title: Palm Crest Phase 3 opens for sales
snippet: Horizon Development launched the third phase of Palm Crest in New Cairo this week.

title: Nile Crest Group raises prices 12% at Zayed Dunes
snippet: Nile Crest Group raised prices at its Zayed Dunes project in Sheikh Zayed by 12% effective December 1, 2026.

title: Sahara Urban extends installments to 12 years in the New Capital
snippet: Sahara Urban introduced a new payment plan at Capital Gardens in the New Administrative Capital: 5% down payment with installments over 12 years.

title: Finovate Technologies opens regional hub in New Cairo, plans 300 hires
snippet: Finovate Technologies opens its new regional headquarters in New Cairo in January 2026, the fintech firm announced.

title: Delta Pharma expands its presence with new Sheikh Zayed offices
snippet: Delta Pharma inaugurated new administrative offices in Sheikh Zayed, expanding its presence in West Cairo.

title: GlobalMove Relocations sees surge in assignees moving to Cairo
snippet: GlobalMove Relocations said it is handling a record number of employees relocating to Cairo in 2026, mostly to New Cairo and Sheikh Zayed.

title: ListingsPlus Egypt partners with banks on mortgage pre-approval
snippet: ListingsPlus Egypt rolls out a mortgage pre-approval feature in partnership with two local banks, the property portal said.

title: Executive moves to New Cairo
snippet: The executive's wife and children moved into a villa in New Cairo last month, according to neighbours.

title: Ten Ramadan recipes to try this year
snippet: Our favourite recipes for the holy month include stuffed vine leaves and kunafa.
